goal.title: Goal
goal.body: Collect your secret treasures one at a time, then return to your start square. The first one home wins.

push.title: Push a tile
push.body: Every turn starts with a push: tap an arrow on the edge of the board and the spare tile slides in, moving the whole row. You can turn the tile first.
push.more: The tile pushed out at the other end is the next spare. A pawn pushed out comes back at the other end of the row. You may not undo the previous push by pushing the same row straight back.

walk.title: Walk
walk.body: After the push, walk along open corridors as far as you like – or stay where you are. The squares you can reach are marked.

treasure.title: Treasures
treasure.body: Your target is shown in the player list and as a purple frame on the board. Stop on its tile to collect it and see your next target. You cannot see the others' targets.

home.title: Return home
home.body: Once all your treasures are found, your target is your start square. Whoever gets there first wins.

daily.title: Daily puzzle
daily.body: One solo game a day, the same for everyone: take your pawn to one treasure in as few turns as possible. The best possible result is shown, and there is no time limit.
daily.more: You can undo moves and try again. Your best attempt is the day's result.
